steps.content: The mechanical dragon lies paralyzed on the floor, thick steam leaking out of the various machine parts all over its body.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hand over the power source, Cyrus. You've lost.
Held at sword point by Tetya, Cyrus is unable to fight, and you've wrecked all his creations. It seems that you're about to complete the first step of saving the world.

steps.speaker: Cyrus
steps.content: <size=44>Impossible! Impossible! You runts! Weaklings! You think you can stop me?!</size>
His face twisted, Cyrus yells hysterically, just like the useless, raging villain he is. Suddenly, you hear a sarcastic chuckle.
With that chuckle, Tetya takes a step forward and aims the tip of her sword at Cyrus.

steps.speaker: Tetya
steps.content: You've lost! Hand it over if you want a chance to live!
Cyrus looks up at the sky as if watching something. When he lowers his head, you find that his expression has become even more insane.
(Transition)

steps.speaker: Cyrus
steps.content: You don't understand! <color=#fb9259>The Dragon of Genesis</color> no longer exists!

steps.speaker: Cyrus
steps.content: I'm the new Dragon of Genesis! I'm the one who's been chosen to save the world!
The dark-blue power source emerges near Cyrus's chest. A loud mechanical rumbling starts behind him. The clock begins turning rapidly around the power source.
The legendary mechanical dragon who brings about the calamities is only a ploy Cyrus made up. The power source causing the Ice Plague has always been on him.

The clock flashes an ominous red light. Under its influence, everything around you seems to slow down, and a heavy pressure forms in the air. Tetya looks terrified, the sword in her hand inching forward carefully.

steps.speaker: Game Master
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=44>Stop, stop, stop!</color></size>
The berserk Cyrus is suddenly frozen. The self-destruction he's about to launch is put on pause with everything in this world.

steps.speaker: Game Master
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>It's all your fault! You've broken it!</color>
A cold finger emerges out of nowhere and taps your forehead. You feel your body changing rapidly, a black coat appearing on you.

steps.speaker: Game Master
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Those who fail the challenge will become <color=#fb9259>NPCs</color>. Though you broke Cyrus, I'm quite satisfied with your performance as a noob. I'll reward you by making you the next <color=#fb9259>Cyrus</color>!</color>

steps.speaker: Game Master
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Aren't you happy about that?</color>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's... cheating...
The particles forming your body tremble ceaselessly. Arduously, you protest.

steps.speaker: Game Master
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>That's not cheating. It's just how the world works. It happened to the guy in front of you as well!</color>
If you fail the game, you'll get turned into an NPC by the Game Master. Cyrus hasn't always been this fraudulent, soulless villain. He was once a <color=#fb9259>player</color> too.

steps.speaker: Cyrus
steps.content: It's me... I'm the new Dragon of Genesis... I'm supposed to be the Chosen One to save the world!

He has been designed to be the avatar of the Ice Plague and the Evil Dragon who brings the Calamity. But deep down, he still wants to save the world, he wants to clear the game that he could never clear again.
Still frozen, Cyrus vanishes bit by bit before your eyes while you turn into him. The bitterness, the anger, and the sad cries... You seem to be able to hear his thoughts now that you've transformed.

steps.speaker: Tetya
steps.content: No... No way!
In the still world, you heard a crackling, shattering sound, like an iceberg crumbling slowly into the sea.
The blade pierces into the void in front of you, hitting that invisible figure manipulating your transformation.
It's Tetya. She's defied her creator, although she doesn't quite know what she's attacking, or what consequence will follow.

steps.speaker: Game Master
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Ohh my, I'm only scaring him a little. Don't get so worked up!</color>
steps.female_content: <color=#7683a2>Ohh my, I'm only scaring her a little. Don't get so worked up!</color>

steps.content: Somehow, you sense that the invisible gaze is fixating at Tetya. Her voice didn't give away any anger of being betrayed by an NPC, but Tetya's body is disintegrating little by little.

steps.speaker: Game Master
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Hmm... That's a good twist, fits her character too. I've gotta note it down and make it a playable route in Tetya's storyline.</color>

Attacking the Game Master has resulted in retaliation by the rules. Tetya's body is trembling in the dark, but she doesn't seem to hear the Game Master's voice, and neither is she aware that her body is vanishing. She only stares at you intently.

steps.speaker: Tetya
steps.content:
Promise...
Till... the world is saved...
Transition, long black screen
You're in the pitch-black void.

steps.speaker: Game Master
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Alright, the next adventure begins now. Let's set off again!</color>
The cold finger taps your forehead, and you once again return to the game world.
